label.zh-TW: App Store：BIGO LIVE 直播（開發者網站為 bigo.tv）
label.en: App Store: BIGO LIVE (developer website on bigo.tv)

steps.zh-TW: 點擊「立即註冊」：本站會先複製邀請碼 10680329250，再開啟 BIGO LIVE 的分享連結（2026-10-24 會轉到 bigo.tv 官網首頁，邀請碼不在網址內）。
steps.en: Select “Sign up”: code 10680329250 is copied, then the BIGO LIVE share link opens (on 2026-10-24 it redirected to bigo.tv; the code is not in the address).

steps.zh-TW: 依官網或 App 商店頁面的指示下載並開啟 BIGO LIVE；這是 18 歲以上的 App，註冊前請先確認自己符合條件。
steps.en: Download and open BIGO LIVE as the website or app store page directs; it is an 18+ app, so check that you qualify before registering.

steps.zh-TW: 依分享文案，新用戶填寫邀請碼 10680329250（貼上或手動輸入）；本站沒有找到說明輸入位置的官方頁面，找不到欄位時請依 App 畫面指示。
steps.en: Per the share text, new users enter invite code 10680329250 (paste or type it); no official page on where it goes was found, so follow the app's screens.

intro.zh-TW: BIGO LIVE 是須年滿 18 歲的直播與聊天 App；依分享文案，新用戶填寫邀請碼 10680329250。
intro.en: BIGO LIVE is an 18+ live-streaming and chat app; per its share text, new users enter invite code 10680329250.

description.zh-TW:
BIGO LIVE 是新加坡 Bigo Technology Pte. Ltd. 營運的直播與聊天 App。使用者可以看直播，也能用 App 內購買的虛擬貨幣送禮物；App Store 台灣版的年齡分級為 18+，並含 App 內購買。

本站的連結不含邀請碼：點擊「立即註冊」時，本站會先複製邀請碼 10680329250，再開啟 BIGO LIVE 的分享短網址。依分享文案，新用戶填寫這組邀請碼「有額外驚喜」，但文案沒有說明內容、金額、期限或對象，所以本頁不列出優惠。

儲值與送禮都是真實花費，請量力而為；本站不推薦儲值，也不保證任何收益。邀請碼是否被平台接受，沒有測試過，實際內容以 BIGO LIVE 官方公告為準。
description.en:
BIGO LIVE is a live-streaming and chat app operated by Bigo Technology Pte. Ltd. of Singapore. Users can watch live streams and send gifts bought with an in-app virtual currency. The Taiwan App Store rates the app 18+ and lists in-app purchases.

The link on this page does not carry the invite code. Selecting “Sign up” first copies code 10680329250 and then opens BIGO LIVE's shared short link. According to the share text, new users who enter this code get unspecified “extra surprises”; the text gives no content, amount, deadline or eligibility, so no offer is listed here.

Top-ups and gifts cost real money, so spend within your means; this site does not recommend top-ups and does not promise any earnings. Whether the platform accepts the code was not tested, and actual terms follow BIGO LIVE's official announcements.

notes.zh-TW:
此連結不含邀請碼，需貼上或手動輸入；點擊「立即註冊」時本站會先複製邀請碼。連結是 BIGO LIVE 分享功能產生的短網址（slink.bigovideo.tv）：2026-10-24 維運者用瀏覽器開啟，轉址到 bigo.tv 官網首頁，不是邀請專屬頁或 App 商店頁，網址也不含邀請碼。邀請碼是否被 BIGO LIVE 接受（在哪個畫面輸入、是否生效），沒有人註冊測試過。

優惠：分享文案只說新用戶填寫邀請碼「有額外驚喜」，沒有金額、期限或對象；這是平台自己的文案，不是本站的主張。本站沒有找到現行的邀請獎勵條款，所以不列出優惠，也無法確認平台條款是否允許第三方網站公開推廣邀請碼。平台可能隨時調整，實際內容以官方公告為準。

年齡與消費：依平台條款，使用者須年滿 18 歲才能註冊（請自行查閱條款）。使用者以 App 內購買的虛擬貨幣（Diamonds）送禮，是真實花費。本站不推薦儲值，也不保證任何收益。網路上有許多非官方的「BIGO LIVE 儲值」「鑽石折扣」「邀請碼」網站，與官方無關，請只透過 bigo.tv 或 App 商店上的官方上架頁面下載與購買。

營運者與網域：營運者為 Bigo Technology Pte. Ltd.（新加坡），依 bigo.tv 頁尾與 App Store 賣家資訊。本站查閱的 BIGO LIVE 官方頁面（官網、App Store 清單）都沒有點名 bigovideo.tv，slink.bigovideo.tv 的歸屬靠間接證據（上述轉址、頁面載入 BIGO 旗下 bigolive.tv 的資源、第三方歸類），所以本站只列這個完整主機，不列父網域 bigovideo.tv。名稱相近的網站不一定相關。短網址的終點可由擁有者變更，請在繼續前確認最終網址。
notes.en:
This link does not carry the invite code, so paste or type it; this site copies the code first when you select “Sign up”. The link is a short URL generated by BIGO LIVE's share function (slink.bigovideo.tv): on 2026-10-24 the maintainer opened it in a browser and it redirected to the bigo.tv home page, not an invite-specific page or an app store page, and the address does not contain the code. Whether BIGO LIVE accepts the code (which screen takes it and whether it takes effect) was not tested, because nobody registered.

Offer: the share text only says new users who enter the code get “extra surprises”, with no amount, deadline or eligibility; this is the platform's own wording and not a claim by this site. No current invite reward terms were found, so no offer is listed, and it could not be confirmed whether the platform's terms allow third-party sites to promote invite codes publicly. The platform may change things at any time, and actual terms follow the official announcements.

Age and spending: per the platform's terms, users must be at least 18 years old to register (check the terms yourself). Viewers send gifts with a virtual currency (Diamonds) bought in the app, which costs real money. This site does not recommend top-ups and does not promise any earnings. Many unofficial “BIGO LIVE top-up”, “diamond discount” and “invite code” sites exist and are unrelated to the official service; download and buy only through bigo.tv or the official app store listing.

Operator and domains: the operator is Bigo Technology Pte. Ltd. (Singapore), per the bigo.tv footer and the App Store seller. None of the official BIGO LIVE pages this site checked (the website, the App Store listing) names bigovideo.tv, and slink.bigovideo.tv is attributed through indirect evidence (the redirect above, the page loading resources from BIGO's bigolive.tv, and third-party classification), so this site lists only that full host and not the parent domain bigovideo.tv. Similarly named sites are not necessarily related. The destination of a short link can be changed by its owner, so check the final address before continuing.

q.zh-TW: BIGO LIVE 的邀請碼 10680329250 要在哪裡輸入？
q.en: Where do I enter BIGO LIVE invite code 10680329250?

a.zh-TW: 分享文案只寫新用戶填寫邀請碼，沒有說明輸入位置，本站也沒有找到說明 App 內輸入畫面的官方頁面，沒有人註冊測試過。請依 App 的畫面指示，若有邀請碼欄位，就貼上或手動輸入；分享連結的網址不含邀請碼，所以點擊「立即註冊」時本站會先複製。
a.en: The share text only says that new users enter the invite code and does not say where, and no official page describing the in-app entry screen was found; nobody registered to test it. Follow the app's screens, and if there is an invite code field, paste or type the code there. The share link's address does not contain the code, so this site copies it first when you select “Sign up”.

q.zh-TW: BIGO LIVE 的邀請碼有什麼優惠？
q.en: What does the BIGO LIVE invite code offer?

a.zh-TW: 分享文案只提到新用戶填寫邀請碼「有額外驚喜」，沒有說明內容、金額、期限或對象，本站也沒有找到現行的官方邀請條款，所以本頁不列出優惠。實際規則以 BIGO LIVE 官方公告為準。
a.en: The share text only says that new users who enter the invite code get “extra surprises”, without any content, amount, deadline or eligibility, and no current official invite terms were found, so no offer is listed on this page. Actual rules follow BIGO LIVE's official announcements.
